1.web: Yahweh, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
1.asv: O Jehovah my God, in thee do I take refuge: Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me,

2.web: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
2.asv: Lest they tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

3.web: Yahweh, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
3.asv: O Jehovah my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;

4.web: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, if I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),
4.asv: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me (Yea, I have delivered him that without cause was mine adversary);

5.web: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
5.asv: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; Yea, let him tread my life down to the earth, And lay my glory in the dust. [Selah

6.web: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
6.asv: Arise, O Jehovah, in thine anger; Lift up thyself against the rage of mine adversaries, And awake for me; thou hast commanded judgment.

7.web: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
7.asv: And let the congregation of the peoples compass thee about; And over them return thou on high.

8.web: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
8.asv: Jehovah ministereth judgment to the peoples: Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and to mine integrity that is in me.

9.web: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
9.asv: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish thou the righteous: For the righteous God trieth the minds and hearts.

10.web: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
10.asv: My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart.

11.web: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
11.asv: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day.

12.web: If a man doesn’t relent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
12.asv: If a man turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready;

13.web: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
13.asv: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; He maketh his arrows fiery shafts.

14.web: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
14.asv: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

15.web: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
15.asv: He hath made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.

16.web: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
16.asv: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.

17.web: I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
17.asv: I will give thanks unto Jehovah according to his righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of Jehovah Most High.
